name: iMining Blockchain and Cryptocurrency Inc.
summary: iMining Blockchain and Cryptocurrency Inc., a blockchain and cryptocurrency company, engages in the cryptocurrency mining business. It mines for bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies, and invests in blockchain-based projects. The company was formerly known as Parlane Resource Corp. and changed its name to iMining Blockchain and Cryptocurrency Inc. in April 2018. iMining Blockchain and Cryptocurrency Inc. was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Vancouver, Canada.
